caseno: Appeal from Original Decree No. 90 of 1969.
lawyer:
B. K. Das—For the Appellant. 
B. N. Chowdhury with Kazi Ebadul Huq—For the Respondent.
parties:
Ajitananda Vikshu  ----- Appellant.
Vs.
Aggrabangsha  Mohathero & others  ----- Respondents.
full_judgment: 13. Agrabangsha Mohathero, the respondent No. 1 in this appeal contested the suit but subsequently at the time of final hearing on 26-2-76 he did not appear and the suit was decreed ex-parte. The order of the Court was to the following effect: "the suit be decreed ex-parte with costs against the principal defendant Nos. 1 and 2. That the plaintiff's title to suit property be declared and he be declared as constituted successor in place of late Dharma Ratna Mohathero in respect of Raja Vihar at Rajanagar and the plaintiff do get khas possession thereof by evicting the defendants 1 and 2 therefrom " The appellant has filed certified copy of the said decree as annexure 'A' to his application for additional evidence. The suit was filed pursuant to the resolution passed by the "The Pakistan Sangbaraj Bhikhu Mahasabha" appointing the appellant as head of the Vihar as successor to late Dharmaratna Mahothero and certified copy of the same has also been filed as annexure "B" to the petition. The said annexure 'B' was also filed in Title Suit No. 101 of 1974 and that was marked as Ext. 3 in that suit. The appellant asserts that pursuant to the said decree he has taken possession of the office as also of the other properties including the landed property of the Vihar. In order to prove this he filed certified copies of the writs of delivery of possession which as annexures "C" and "D" which show that possession has been taken by the appellant in the property of Rajanagar Raj Vihar. All these tend to show that Agrabangsha Mohathero is no longer the head of the Rajanagar Raj Vihar, rather the appellant is the bead of the said Vihar. Mr. Das, therefore, argues that subsequent events have to be taken into consideration in deciding the appeal.
